fact: Banco de Moçambique Governor Felisberto Navalha said Mozambique is finalising preparations to join the SARB-hosted SADC RTGS and expects to be integrated in the first quarter of 2027, so customers can settle South African invoices from metical accounts.
SARB's June 2026 SADC-RTGS statistics list Mozambique as a participating country with six participating banks (Absa, Access Bank, FNB, Nedbank, Mozabanco, Standard Bank).
SARB's June 2026 SADC-RTGS per-country table gives Mozambique 215 settled transactions with a value of ZAR 261.79 million.
MTN's MoMo app opened a wallet corridor from South Africa to Mozambique, so migrants in South Africa can send money home to wallets there, ITWeb reports.
